title: Father and Jupiter
body: Astrology makes much of the position of the planets at the moment of one's birth. The only known force a planet exerts on Earth is gravitational. At birth, a $$4.20-kg$$ baby has a 100-kg father $$0.200\, \text{m}$$ away, and Jupiter (mass $$1.898\times10**{27}\,\text{kg}$$) $$is$$ $$at$$ $$its$$ $$closest$$ $$distance$$ $$to$$ $$Earth$$, $$some$$ $$6.29\times10**{11}\,\text{m}$$ away. Take G=$$6.674\times10**{-11}\,\tfrac{\text{N}\cdot\text{m}**2}{\text{kg}**2}$$.
